mechanism: Ondansetron may mask ototoxicity symptoms from gentamicin, and both drugs can affect QT interval; gentamicin may increase ondansetron levels through renal function impairment.
action: Monitor for ototoxicity symptoms (tinnitus, hearing loss) and cardiac effects; ensure adequate hydration and monitor renal function; consider alternative antiemetic if gentamicin-induced renal impairment develops.
